messages:
drew: Quick postmortem follow-up from the LB/DNS retry surge yesterday. Need owners + short timelines. Root causes: stale SNI cache + permissive fallback + intermittent egress resets.

anya: I'll take the immediate mitigation: add a forced cache-refresh endpoint and temporarily lower SNI TTLs for high-traffic routes. ETA: tomorrow AM.

marcus: I'll own the config change to make fallback behavior explicit (opt-in). Will draft schema change and migration plan. ETA: Fri EOD.

sophie: I'll build a small integration that reproduces cert-rotate + egress RSTs; want it in perf-ci. ETA: Thu noon.

monitor-bot: Incident created: REM-2026-099. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/REM-2026-099. Reminder set: @anya in 24h.

drew: Deployment constraints: fallback-change is behavioral. Canary at 5% for 30m with synthetic probe that simulates cross-region cert rotate. Auto rollback on probe failure.

anya: Patch branch pushed: `git@repo:redwood/infra#sni-refresh-temp`. Added admin curl: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/internal/refresh-sni?route=api-*`.

marcus: Notes on schema: adding `fallback_policy` enum (allow|reject|log). Default to `allow` for safety, opt-in `reject`. Will include migration doc.

sophie: Test plan: job `ci/routing-replay` that spins two regions, triggers cert rotate, injects TCP RSTs, asserts no fallback and retry_rate < 0.5%.

monitor-bot: New alert created: retry_spike_with_sni_tag -> fires if retries > 100/min and pct_fallback > 5% for 5m. Pager: network oncall.

drew: Two decisions to confirm: 1) targeted TTL vs global (anya proposes targeted), 2) default fallback_policy.

anya: I vote targeted TTL to limit blast radius.

marcus: Agree default `allow`. We'll enable `reject` per-tenant until tests clear.

drew: Decision recorded: targeted TTL + default allow; reconcile endpoint SRE-only. Action recap: anya (TTL+refresh, ETA tomorrow AM), marcus (schema+PR, ETA Fri), sophie (harness, ETA Thu).

anya: I'll mark REM-2026-099 In Progress after PR.

marcus: Opening draft PR now: https://git.redwood/infra/lb-config/pulls/500. Needs review.

sophie: Harness PR: https://git.redwood/perf/ci/pulls/101. Requesting perms to run job.

monitor-bot: Weekly check-ins scheduled Tue 09:00 until REM-2026-099 is closed. Assigned: @drew @anya @marcus @sophie.

drew: Also proposing a monthly networking pattern review to track recurrence across routes; want to co-chair with someone.

sophie: I'll co-chair with you.

drew: Thanks folks. Please update postmortem with links and set tasks to In Progress when started. I'll do a 24h rollup. :thumbsup:
